summary: A working app shell with a rail, panel and page content whose pathname lives in local state and updates on navigation.
use: Wiring the shell into an app: the router owns the URL and the shell receives it as a prop.
spec: `const modules: NavModule[]` has two modules, `id: 'app'` and `id: 'account'`, with 3 items each
`let pathname = $state('/app/dashboard')` is the only navigation state
`function intercept(e: MouseEvent)` turns in-stage `a[href^="/"]` clicks into `pathname` updates
Page is `<PageShell title={titles[pathname] ?? 'Page'} description={pathname}>` with a `KpiGrid` of 2 `KpiCard` items: Revenue and Users
